title: Throughput fingerprint + p95 drift bisector for core LLM models
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Goal: Build and maintain a robust tokens-per-second microbenchmark suite that fingerprints throughput behavior and detects p95 regressions across our core serving models and quantization variants. This ticket implements a higher-fidelity harness that (a) generates reproducible cadence patterns, (b) warms KV caches predictably, (c) computes stable p95 lineage, and (d) runs statistical drift tests and a bisector tool to isolate regressions to a model binary, kernel change, or infra commit.

Scope (MVP):
- A modular load generator that can produce: steady-token streams, microbursts, and token-slew patterns with configurable token cadence and latencies.
- KV warmup sequencer to pre-populate caches and a control variant that measures cold vs warm performance.
- p95 extraction pipeline producing per-run summaries (p50,p90,p95,p99,throughput,token-loss) persisted as artifacts to S3 and exposed to Console.
- Drift detector using two complementary signals: EWMA of p95 and a distributional KS test comparing current latency samples against a rolling baseline.
- Bisector automation: when a drift is detected, run binary search across recent CI commits and quant profiles to produce a ranked list of likely culprits and attach suspected PRs.
- CI integration: nightly suite runs for core models matrix (model, quant, sequence_length). Failure -> create a Linear artifact + Slack alert targeted to infra/model-oncall.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Harness can run end-to-end for 3 core models (small/medium/large) under two quantization profiles and emit artifacts to S3.
2) p95 drift rule triggers with a configurable threshold (default: 15% sustained delta) and posts an actionable report with candidate commits.
3) New dashboard in Console with per-model throughput fingerprints and p95 trendlines, including run metadata (seed, prompt-corpus, KV-state).
4) Bisector reduces suspect commit range to <= 8 commits in >70% of regressions in our smoke history replay.
5) Tests added to CI to prevent regressions in the harness itself.

Design notes / trade-offs:
- We intentionally emulate production token cadence (short live streams + intermittent long tails) rather than synthetic full-length single-shot prompts, because cadence affects batching and kernel selection.
- For statistical testing we use a lightweight KS test for distributional shifts and an EWMA-based detection for sustained drift; KS catches shape changes while EWMA reduces sensitivity to noise.
- Bisector will prioritize binary and kernel-level rollbacks before infra/flaky network events; that ordering reflects common regression root causes seen in last 18 months.
- We will store raw samples for 7 days and aggregated summaries for 90 days to balance observability needs and storage costs.

Implementation plan (high level):
- Week 1: scaffold harness repo, load generator, KV warmup module, basic run harness and S3 artifact writer.
- Week 2: per-run p95 calculator, sample retention, and Console integration (ingest pipeline).
- Week 3: implement drift detectors (EWMA + KS) and alerting playbook.
- Week 4: bisector automation and CI gating; run replay on historical failure windows to calibrate thresholds.
- Follow-up: expand model matrix, add quant-profile regression tagging, harden run stability (retries/backoff).

Run parameters (configurable):
- models: list of model names
- quant_profiles: e.g., fp16, q8_0, q4_1
- seq_lengths: [64, 256, 1024]
- cadence_patterns: steady|microburst|slew
- kv_warmup_tokens: integer

Artifacts & outputs:
- run_manifest.json (seed, commit, docker image, model, quant, cadence)
- samples.csv (latency_ms, token_index, stream_id) 
- summary.json (p50,p90,p95,p99,throughput_tokens_per_sec,errors)
- bisect_report.md (if drift)

Telemetry & alerting:
- Console metric: throughput.fingerprint.{model}.{quant}.{pattern} (histogram + p95)
- Slack channel: #tps-regressions (automated alerts including brief bisect results)
- Pager policy: oncall only when bisector confidence >= 0.8 and customer_impact=high

Operational runbook (short):
- If p95 drift alert triggers: check bisect_report attached to Linear issue; run replay for the failing commit locally with same cadence; escalate to model/serving binary author if bisector points to code change.

Notes on reproducibility:
- Prompt corpus will be sampled from anonymized production shadows bucket; seed must be preserved in run_manifest to reproduce exact token boundaries.
- Use container images pinned by digest for model runtime during CI runs to ensure bisector accuracy.
